name: Elftopia
blurb: Fantasy festival at Ooidonk Castle near Ghent, with cosplay, storytellers, fire performers, falconers and fantasy authors.

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown: 'Le Fantasy Fest Belge 14 - 15 août 2027'; guests page: 'Elftopia welcomes you at Ooidonk Castle Saturday 14 August 2027 ... Sunday 15 August 2027'

notes: Guests page says outright 'The guests will be announced soon', so guests is "none-yet" for the Aug 2027 edition. No distinct organizing company name is shown anywhere on the site (only 'Website by ESKIDOOS.be', the web developer, same as this batch's Comic Con Brussels — likely just a shared site-builder, not a shared organizer), so organizer is listed as the event brand itself. Ooidonk Castle sits in/near Nazareth and Deinze, Belgium; keeping Deinze as given since the site itself only says 'near the city of Ghent' without naming a specific municipality.
